title: Compactor
description: Datapack for Decorative block compacting and tweaking Storage/Utility blocks!
body:
# Choco's Compactor!

Do you find it outrageous to spend 80 Ice Cubes for just one Blue Ice? Or wanted to farm Corals and Fungus blocks renewably, without completely obliterating Ice Spike, Coral Reef or Nether Forest biomes! 

This recipepack introduces compacting certain Cosmetic blocks and unpacking new Storage blocks, as well as increasing the stack-size of certain crafted items.

### Other Resources
Visit [Chocos/mygazthehealer](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/mygazthehealer/) in PlanetMinecraft for reporting issues or discussions/recommendation/suggestions for the pack. Refer the gallery for a complete list of recipes changed/added.

### NOTE
If you disagree with a certain recipe but still want to use this datapack, you may delete the .json file corresponding to that recipe. Feel free to edit this recipepack for your personal preference!
